dog.description_text: Tabitha is currently with one of our fosters. Here’s what we know so far about her time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/r/sites/GRP_NYC_Foster/Shared%20Documents/Forms/AllItems.aspx?id=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral%2FTabitha%20%2D%20About%20Me%2Epdf&parent=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral&p=true&share=cQqU%5Fn5W8sLDR7A%5F3ebU1kFBEgUC%2D1CbtPqOU8ruMlp8BG4YmQ Her foster says "At first, she was quite tense and scared of everything, but it didn’t take her long to gradually warm up to us. She’s also very vocal and will let you know when she wants something or is looking for attention. She’s definitely food-motivated as well. She will occasionally curl up on your lap and ask for pets and cuddles in the mornings! ". She loves to chat! She does not like being shut out of the room at night, she likes to sleep with you. She has been spayed, vaccinated, microchipped , and has had preventative treatments to ensure she is ready for her next steps. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
